cards.front: I hope this email finds you well.
cards.back: 希望你收到這封信時一切都好。(模板級高頻,正式但不冷)
cards.hint: 替代:I hope you're doing well.(隨意)

cards.front: I am writing to inquire about [topic].
cards.back: 我寫信來詢問 [主題]。(主動聯絡 / 第一次接觸)
cards.hint: inquire 比 ask 正式;reach out 是隨意版

cards.front: Thank you for your email regarding [topic].
cards.back: 謝謝你關於 [主題] 的來信。(正式回信開頭)
cards.hint: 替代:Thanks for getting in touch.(輕鬆)

cards.front: My name is [Name] and I am the [role] at [company].
cards.back: 我是 [姓名],[公司] 的 [職位]。(自我介紹)
cards.hint: 對方不認識你時用,常配「I am writing to inquire」一起

cards.front: I would like to inform you that [event].
cards.back: 我想告知您 [事件]。(最正式通知開場)
cards.hint: 替代:I wanted to let you know that ...(隨意)

cards.front: Please be advised that there will be a delay in [process].
cards.back: 請注意 [流程] 將會延遲。(通知延遲)
cards.hint: Please be advised 是商務專用,比 sorry 早一步嚴肅

cards.front: I am pleased to confirm that [result].
cards.back: 我很高興地確認 [結果]。(通知好消息)
cards.hint: pleased 比 happy 更正式;給上級 / 客戶用

cards.front: This is a friendly reminder that [deadline] is approaching.
cards.back: 友善提醒 [截止日] 即將到來。
cards.hint: 「催但不兇」的英文表達,直接寫 reminder 偏硬

cards.front: Following up on my previous email regarding [topic].
cards.back: 延續上一封關於 [主題] 的信。
cards.hint: 商務 Email 第二高頻片語(僅次於 Best regards)

cards.front: As of [date], [person] will be taking over [role].
cards.back: 自 [日期] 起,[某人] 將接手 [職位]。(人事異動)
cards.hint: As of = 從某天起,商務通用

cards.front: Effective [date], we will be implementing [change].
cards.back: 自 [日期] 起,我們將開始實施 [改變]。(政策變更)
cards.hint: Effective + 日期 = 正式公告語

cards.front: Could you please [verb] ... ?
cards.back: 請問你可以 [動作] 嗎?(最萬用禮貌請求)
cards.hint: Could > Can(更客氣),please 加在動詞前

cards.front: Would it be possible to [verb] ... ?
cards.back: 請問是否可能 [動作]?(請對方額外付出)
cards.hint: 隱含「我知道可能麻煩」,適合上級

cards.front: Could you provide me with [item]?
cards.back: 請你提供我 [物品]?(要資料)
cards.hint: provide me with 比 give me 正式;合約 / 文件用

cards.front: Could you confirm whether [statement]?
cards.back: 你能確認 [事項] 是否正確嗎?
cards.hint: whether 比 if 在書面更正式

cards.front: I would appreciate it if you could [verb] by [date].
cards.back: 如果你能在 [日期] 前 [動作],我會很感謝。(委婉催進度)
cards.hint: 英文軟催魔法句;客戶 / 老闆讀了不反感

cards.front: At your earliest convenience, could you ...?
cards.back: 在你方便的時候,請問你可以 ...?
cards.hint: 「盡早,但你方便就好」,看似客氣其實是催

cards.front: This is time-sensitive — could you respond by [date]?
cards.back: 這件事有時效性 — 請你 [日期] 前回覆?(緊急請求)
cards.hint: time-sensitive 比 urgent 軟,給尊重

cards.front: No rush — let me know if [condition].
cards.back: 不急 — 如果 [狀況] 就告訴我。(給對方台階)
cards.hint: 讓對方放心,配請求句一起用很萬用

cards.front: Apologies for the delayed response.
cards.back: 抱歉延遲回覆。(超萬用)
cards.hint: 沒在 24 小時內回信開頭都該加;比 sorry for the late reply 正式

cards.front: I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
cards.back: 對於可能造成的任何不便,我深感抱歉。(模板級)
cards.hint: 客服信件大量使用

cards.front: I would like to sincerely apologize for [mistake].
cards.back: 我想為 [錯誤] 真誠地道歉。(重大失誤)
cards.hint: sincerely 加重份量,不能拿來道歉小事

cards.front: The issue was caused by [reason], and we are taking steps to prevent it from happening again.
cards.back: 這問題是因為 [原因] 造成,我們正在採取措施防止再發生。
cards.hint: we are taking steps 比 we will fix 強(已經動了)

cards.front: As a token of our apology, we would like to offer [compensation].
cards.back: 作為我們道歉的表示,我們想提供 [補償]。
cards.hint: 客戶服務常用;token = 一點表達

cards.front: We will ensure this does not happen again.
cards.back: 我們會確保這不會再發生。
cards.hint: ensure 比 make sure 更正式書面

cards.front: Thank you for your patience and understanding.
cards.back: 感謝你的耐心與諒解。
cards.hint: 道歉信幾乎一定要這句結尾,客戶氣消一半

cards.front: I would like to schedule a meeting to discuss [topic].
cards.back: 我想安排一次會議來討論 [主題]。
cards.hint: schedule a meeting 是商務固定搭配

cards.front: Are you available on [day] at [time] or [day] at [time]?
cards.back: 你 [星期幾] [時間] 或 [星期幾] [時間] 有空嗎?
cards.hint: 永遠提供 2 個選項;別問「什麼時候有空」

cards.front: Please let me know what works best for you.
cards.back: 請告訴我哪個時間對你最方便。
cards.hint: works best for you 比 is convenient 順口

cards.front: The meeting is scheduled for [day, date] at [time] in [location].
cards.back: 會議定於 [星期, 日期] [時間],在 [地點 / Zoom 連結]。
cards.hint: scheduled for = 「定於」,正式

cards.front: Please find the agenda and pre-read materials attached.
cards.back: 議程與預習材料請見附件。
cards.hint: Please find ... attached 是附件標準句

cards.front: Just a quick reminder about our meeting tomorrow at [time].
cards.back: 小提醒我們明天 [時間] 的會議。
cards.hint: Just a quick reminder = 「順帶提醒一下」

cards.front: Unfortunately, I need to reschedule our meeting due to [reason].
cards.back: 不好意思,因為 [原因] 我需要改期。
cards.hint: reschedule 比 cancel 更建設性

closing.title: 結尾 / 附件 / 追問 13 句

cards.front: Best regards,
cards.back: 此致,(最常用結尾)
cards.hint: 客戶 / 老闆 / 同事都通;Kind regards 稍微更暖

cards.front: Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
cards.back: 如有任何問題請別猶豫聯絡我。
cards.hint: 模板級;商務客戶服務必用

cards.front: Looking forward to your response.
cards.back: 期待您的回覆。
cards.hint: 替代:I look forward to hearing from you.(更正式)

cards.front: Thank you in advance for your assistance.
cards.back: 先謝過你的協助。
cards.hint: in advance = 事先;委託請求時超常用

cards.front: Have a great day!
cards.back: 祝你有美好的一天!(美式商務隨意收尾)
cards.hint: 歐洲 / 亞洲商務較少用

cards.front: Please find [item] attached.
cards.back: [物品] 請見附件。
cards.hint: 附件提醒固定句

cards.front: I have attached the [item 1] and [item 2] for your reference.
cards.back: 我附上 [物 1] 與 [物 2] 供您參考。(多附件)

cards.front: You can find more information at [link].
cards.back: 更多資訊請參考 [連結]。

cards.front: I have shared the [doc] with you. Please review it at your convenience.
cards.back: 我已分享 [文件] 給你。請在方便時審閱。
cards.hint: at your convenience 是商務固定片語

cards.front: Has there been any update on [topic]?
cards.back: [主題] 有任何進展嗎?(追問狀況)

cards.front: Could you confirm receipt of this email?
cards.back: 你能確認收到這封信嗎?
cards.hint: confirm receipt 是商務固定片語

cards.front: As per your previous email, ...
cards.back: 根據你之前的信,...(引用對方話)
cards.hint: As per 比 according to 簡潔

cards.front: I have cc'd [person] on this email.
cards.back: 我把 [某人] 加進這封信的 cc。
cards.hint: cc'd 讀作 cee-cee-d

cards.front: I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to ...
cards.back: 暖開頭 + 直接說明來意 — 模板 1 的雙句串接。
cards.hint: 請求類 Email 標準雙開頭

cards.front: ... and as a token of our apology, ...
cards.back: 道歉接補償的轉折 — 道歉信第 4-5 步銜接。
cards.hint: 前面解釋原因 / 改善動作之後接這句切換到補償

cards.front: ... once confirmed. Please find [item] attached.
cards.back: 確認 + 附件的順敘 — 會議邀請信收尾用。
cards.hint: 「確認後 + 附件已附」一氣呵成

cards.front: Following up ... Has there been any update on ...?
cards.back: 跟進結構 — 第二次催信的標準雙句。
cards.hint: 第一封信沒回的後續追蹤
